subject: Urgent: Virtual card prepay hold causing declines for Berlin exec workshop
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: reservations@hoteladlon.de
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Simon Taylor <simon.taylor@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:15:00+02:00
Subject: Urgent: Virtual card prepay hold causing declines for Berlin exec workshop

Hi reservations team,

We're preparing the final rooming and attendee prepay for the Redwood x Acme exec workshop arriving 2026-07-13. We submitted a virtual card authorization for the group deposit yesterday, but the card is being declined with an authorization hold message on your side. Attached is the hotel invoice and a screenshot of the decline message from the virtual-card provider.

Can you confirm:
- whether the prepay hold is showing on your merchant account (invoice #BRLN-7321),
- the exact reason for the decline (MCC/authorization mismatch vs. AVS), and
- whether you can accept the authorization code or require a different payment method?

This is time-sensitive — if we can't clear the hold today we will need to switch the deposit to a company wire or request guests pay on arrival and be reimbursed. Acme would prefer we keep the prepay in place to guarantee the negotiated room block rate.

Attachments: hotel_invoice_PREPAY.pdf (PDF, 92KB), virtual_card_auth.png (PNG, 48KB)

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Program Lead, Events
Redwood Inference
From: Hotel Adlon Reservations <reservations@hoteladlon.de>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Taylor <simon.taylor@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T11:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Virtual card prepay hold causing declines for Berlin exec workshop

Good morning Evelyn,

Thanks for sending — we can see an attempted authorization against invoice BRLN-7321 but the auth was declined by the processor and held pending merchant verification. Typical causes we've seen: (1) MCC mismatch for event deposits, (2) card not enabled for pre-authorizations for this merchant, or (3) AVS/CVC failure.

If you can provide the virtual card provider contact or an alternate authorization code we can manually re-submit. Otherwise we will need a wire or a credit-card number that accepts deposits. We can also hold the rooms on a courtesy basis until EOD 2026-07-10 with the negotiated rate, provided we receive confirmation of an alternate payment path.

Please advise — we want to avoid releasing the block.

Best regards,
Helena K.
Group Reservations Manager
Hotel Adlon Kempinski
[Attachment: hotel_action_request_form.pdf (PDF, 40KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, pcard-ops@vendorpay.com
Date: 2026-07-08T12:20:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Virtual card prepay hold causing declines for Berlin exec workshop

Looping in payments ops (pcard-ops) — finance, we need an immediate escalation: the virtual card issued yesterday for Acme group deposit is being rejected by Hotel Adlon due to an 'authorization hold'.

Quick status / ask:
- Kimberly / finance: can you confirm if the virtual card profile for Hotel Adlon allows "lodging prepay" charges? Our vendor has flagged MCC differences before.
- If the provider cannot re-issue a compatible virtual card today, we need a fallback: either (A) wire to Hotel Adlon (they'll hold courtesy), or (B) we reimburse attendees for on-arrival payment and submit a consolidated expense.

Marissa: please pull the final guest list and attach the rooming block details so we can show the hotel the occupancy we're protecting. Evelyn: please keep Acme in the loop — they prefer prepay.

Ben Carter
Head of Events Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: virtual_card_auth.png (PNG, 48KB)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: pcard-ops@vendorpay.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-09T08:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Virtual card prepay hold causing declines for Berlin exec workshop

Finance ops here — we investigated with VendorPay. Findings: the virtual-card token was issued with an MCC restriction that excludes "event deposits" and some hotel prepay vendors. Processor blocked due to MCC mismatch. VendorPay can:

- Option 1: Re-issue a new virtual card with the correct MCC mapping within 2 hours (requires Hotel Adlon to accept tokenization and attempt auth again).
- Option 2: Issue a wire to Hotel Adlon today (requires banking details and internal approval; ETA same-day SEPA if we kick now).

Recommendation: try Option 1 immediately. Marissa — can you confirm the hotel's merchant descriptor and send Helena the copy of the rooming manifest so the hotel knows this is the negotiated block? If Helena confirms acceptance of a re-issued token we will push Option 1 now.

Kimberly Park
Finance Manager, Travel & Expense
Redwood Inference
From: Hotel Adlon Reservations <reservations@hoteladlon.de>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Taylor <simon.taylor@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T18:42:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Virtual card prepay hold causing declines for Berlin exec workshop

Hi Evelyn / team,

Thanks for the follow-ups and for sending the rooming manifest. We accepted the new tokenization details from your processor this morning and successfully captured the deposit for invoice BRLN-7321. The hold has been released and the room block remains confirmed under the negotiated group rate.

Please note the capture reference: ADL-BRLN-20260711-4592. Attached is the updated invoice marked "PAID" for your records.

If you still prefer a wire for accounting, let us know and we can issue a credit, but the token capture is complete and the block is secure.

Regards,
Helena K.
Group Reservations Manager
Hotel Adlon Kempinski
[Attachment: hotel_invoice_PREPAY_paid.pdf (PDF, 94KB)]
